title: Vehicle Body 6DOF Three Axles
text: 具有平移和旋转运动的三轴车辆牵引车车身，输入 8 路、输出 7 路；{Hitch forces} 指定创建挂钩力输入端口、{Hitch moments} 指定创建牵引点力矩输入端口、{Vehicle mass, m} 指定质量、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front axle, a} 指定从质心到前轴的距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to middle axle, b} 指定从质心到中轴的距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear axle, c} 指定从质心到后轴的距离、{Lateral distance from geometric centerline to center of mass, d} 指定从几何中心线到质心的距离、{Vertical distance from center of mass to axle plane, h} 指定距离 .35、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to hitch, dh} 指定从质心到挂钩的纵向距离、{Longitudinal distance from center of mass to hitch, hl} 指定从质心到牵引点的横向距离、{Vertical distance from hitch to axle plane, hh} 指定从牵引点到车轴平面的距离、{Initial position in the inertial frame [Xeo,Yeo,Zeo], Xe_o} 指定初始位置、{Initial velocity in body axes [xdot_o,ydot_o,zdot_o], xbdot_o} 指定初始速度、{Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw], eul_o} 指定初始欧拉旋转、{Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r], p_o} 指定初始旋转速率、{Chassis inertia tensor, Iveh} 指定惯性、{Track widths [front,rear], w} 指定宽度、{Mass, z1m} 指定牵引车前部质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z1R} 指定牵引车前部到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z1I} 指定牵引车前部惯性、{Mass, z2m} 指定驾驶室顶部质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z2R} 指定驾驶室顶部到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z2I} 指定驾驶室顶部惯性、{Mass, z3m} 指定牵引车车架左侧质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z3R} 指定牵引车车架左侧到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z3I} 指定牵引车车架左侧惯性、{Mass, z4m} 指定牵引车车架右侧质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z4R} 指定牵引车车架右侧到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z4I} 指定牵引车车架右侧惯性、{Mass, z5m} 指定驾驶室左侧质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z5R} 指定驾驶室左侧到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z5I} 指定驾驶室左侧惯性、{Mass, z6m} 指定驾驶室右侧质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z6R} 指定驾驶室右侧到前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z6I} 指定驾驶室右侧惯性、{Mass, z7m} 指定牵引车后部质量、{Distance vector from front axle, z7R} 指定牵引车后部质量距前轴的距离、{Inertia tensor, z7I} 指定牵引车后部惯性、{Longitudinal drag area, Af} 指定车辆横截面积、{Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} 指定空气阻力系数 .3、{Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} 指定空气升力系数 .1、{Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} 指定俯仰阻力 .1、{Relative wind angle vector, beta_w} 指定风向角、{Side force coefficient vector, Cs} 指定侧向力阻力、{Yaw moment coefficient vector, Cym} 指定横摆力矩阻力、{Absolute air pressure, Pabs} 指定压力、{Air temperature, Tair} 指定环境空气温度、{Gravitational acceleration, g} 指定重力、{Longitudinal velocity tolerance, xdot_tol} 指定容差 .1、{Geometric longitudinal offset from axle plane, longOff} 指定纵向偏移、{Geometric lateral offset from center plane, latOff} 指定侧向偏移、{Geometric vertical offset from axle plane, vertOff} 指定垂直偏移、{Wrap Euler angles, wrapAng} 指定 on，按实例取值。
